newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal soccer stadium accident kills two girls.
newsitem.headline: Senegal soccer stadium accident kills two girls.

text.p: Two girls were killed and about 40 fans were injured at a soccer match in Senegal when a retaining rail in the stadium's only stand gave way, witnesses and medical sources said.
The accident happened late in Thursday in the Iba Mar Diop stadium in the populous Medina district during a match between two teams from rival districts in the capital Dakar.

Witnesses said that when the rail gave way, one set of fans fell on others beneath them. More tickets had been sold than the stand could accomodate, they added. One person died in an accident at the same stadium five years ago.
The fiercely contested district matches draw more supporters than matches organised by the Senegalese Football Federation.
